_howToEdit: Blogger Agent ki category file. Ise aap freely edit kar sakte hain. Rules: (1) category 'id' change mat karna, warna purane posts ka link toot jayega. (2) 'labels' wahi words use karein jo _fixedLabels me hain. (3) image_style aur diagram_usage wahi hain jo AI ko batate hain ki kaisi image/diagram banani hai. Is file me comment nahi likh sakte (JSON rule), isliye '_' se shuru hone wale fields sirf notes hain aur code inhe category samajhta nahi.

categories.label: AI Updates
categories.description: New AI models, features, tools and launches - and also major AI news like safety issues, privacy debates, new regulations, or a big company changing how its AI works. Write about what happened, why it matters to a normal user, and what to do about it.
categories.audience: Beginners and creators who want to keep up with AI without drowning in jargon.
example_topics: A new AI image tool launched - what it does and who it is for
OpenAI or Anthropic released an update - here is what changed for you
A free AI model became available - is it worth switching?
An AI coding tool added a feature - here is how to use it
An AI tool is in the news for a privacy or safety issue - what it means for you
New AI rules or regulation - what changes for the average user
categories.never_cover: Celebrity gossip, political drama, funding roundup drama, or general technology news that has nothing to do with AI.
categories.evergreen_fallback: how to use a well known AI tool for a specific everyday task, explained step by step. Never claim it is new.
categories.image_style: If the topic is about a chatbot or assistant, show a modern chat interface on a laptop or phone screen. If it is about a model or tool launch, show a clean futuristic illustration of AI or a neural network. Never draw logos, brand marks or real people's faces.
image_subject_examples: an AI assistant conversation on a laptop screen
abstract neural network with glowing connected nodes
a phone showing a clean AI chat app
categories.diagram_usage: Only when the news explains a workflow or a pipeline, for example how a request travels through a new feature. Otherwise skip the diagram.

categories.label: Digital Marketing
categories.description: SEO, social media, content marketing, email marketing, ads, analytics and funnels, including how to use AI tools for all of these. Practical, step-by-step, aimed at people who run their own site or business.
categories.audience: Beginners, small business owners, freelancers and first-time bloggers who want steady traffic and leads.
example_topics: How to do keyword research for a blog post from scratch
A simple SEO checklist you can run on every page
How to plan one month of social media content
Using an AI tool to write email newsletters faster
How to set up a simple marketing funnel for a small blog
categories.never_cover: Celebrity endorsements, get-rich-quick schemes, specific paid ad budget advice, or guaranteed-traffic promises.
categories.evergreen_fallback: not needed, this category is always evergreen practical content.
categories.image_style: Marketing dashboards, growth graphs, a social media content planning board, a marketing funnel illustration, or the concept of search results and ranking. Clean, modern, editorial. No logos or real faces.
image_subject_examples: analytics dashboard with line and bar charts
a marketing funnel drawn in flat illustration
a content calendar board with posts
search results page concept with a highlighted top result
categories.diagram_usage: Yes, this is the main category for diagrams. Good subjects: the marketing funnel (Awareness to Interest to Decision to Action), the SEO process, the content workflow, the email funnel.

categories.label: Vibe Coding
categories.description: Building apps and websites by prompting AI coding tools. Covers Cursor, Claude Code, OpenCode, Lovable, Bolt and similar tools, AI-assisted coding workflows, prompt tips, and small beginner projects that actually work.
categories.audience: Beginners who want to build a small app or website by describing it to an AI, without learning everything first.
example_topics: How to build a simple to-do app by prompting an AI coding tool
Cursor vs Claude Code vs Lovable - which one to start with
Prompt tips that make AI write better code
How to add a login page to your app with AI help
Fixing errors in AI generated code without knowing everything
categories.never_cover: Enterprise architecture debates, salary or job market commentary, or advanced backend engineering theory aimed at senior developers.
categories.evergreen_fallback: not needed, this category is always evergreen practical content.
categories.image_style: A developer desk with a laptop or monitor showing a code editor with an AI assistant panel, terminal windows, and the app being built. Blurred or unreadable code is fine. Clean modern editorial look. No logos, no real faces.
image_subject_examples: laptop showing a code editor with an AI chat panel beside it
two monitors, one with code one with a terminal
a phone and laptop showing a simple app being built
a clean developer desk with keyboard and notebook
categories.diagram_usage: Yes when useful. Good subjects: the prompt-to-app workflow, how an AI coding tool turns a description into files, the debug loop.
